description: coral-agents/seller-agent/coral-agent.toml and coral-agents/seller-agent/README.md were not updated alongside the C0/C3 code changes made to files in the SAME package (service.ts, telemetry.ts, index.ts). The toml's [options] table (lines 18-35) declares no ANICCA_DASHBOARD_URL, SELLER_KEYPAIR_B58, ANICCA_TELEMETRY_URL, or CLAWROUTER_URL, still defaults SERVICES to "txline" (not "anicca,txline"), and its description/readme fields never mention the 'anicca' service or self-report at all. The README's Files table (lines 27-34) does not list telemetry.ts, and its prose (line 3-5) still reads 'It is intentionally TxODDS-only for the demo.' Only the separate coral-agents/seller-worldcup/coral-agent.toml (the manifest round.ts actually uses via idName='seller-worldcup') correctly declares the new options. Given the spec's own C0 finding that 'coral-server rejects undeclared toml options,' this manifest/README drift means: (a) a judge reading the seller-agent package's own docs -- the natural place to look, and the one its own README 'Test'/'Env' sections point at -- gets a materially incomplete and actively misleading picture of what R5/R6 implemented, and (b) if the base seller-agent manifest were ever launched directly (rather than via the seller-worldcup wrapper), it could not accept the new env vars at all.
